meta.note: Design tokens read out of EA's public Battlefield Portal stylesheet. Values only; no EA asset is redistributed here. The binary assets (fonts, images, icons) stay in the user-local mirror.

--button-color.selector: (set inline by the component, not in the stylesheet)

--color.selector: (set inline by the component, not in the stylesheet)
--color.source: index-*.js, IconButton component: style:{"--color": color ?? themeDefault} where themeDefault is theme.colors.primary for the default variant, gray600 for SECONDARY and warningVibrant for THEMED

--hover-color.selector: (set inline by the component, not in the stylesheet)
--hover-color.source: index-*.js, IconButton component: style:{"--hover-color": hoverColor ?? color ?? themeDefault}

radii.note: The site declares no radius token and no radius on any control. Corners are square; the only border-radius declarations in the whole stylesheet are listed below and none belongs to a form control.

shadows.note: The site declares no shadow token and no elevation shadow. Depth is carried by flat value steps and 1px hairlines.

transitions.note: No transition token. Motion is per-component and rare.

zIndex.note: No z-index token. Layers are literal values; the observed set is listed.

hairline.note: the site's default control border width

emphasis.note: hover and focus ring, and the unavailable state

chamferedRing.note: The signature hover and focus affordance: a 2px ring drawn on a ::before inset outside the control, with the four corners cut off by a clip-path polygon. It is not a radius; it is a chamfer.
chamferedRing.inset: -5px on buttons, -4px on inputs and icon buttons

selection.note: The stylesheet declares no ::selection rule; text selection uses the browser default.
